$comment: The tank volume tool (apps/site/src/scripts/volume.ts, pages/vi/cong-cu/the-tich-be.astro): each shape's litres, US gallons and litres to a water line (`fill`, cm from the bottom; `filled` only below the rim), from sizes in cm; the tanks it refuses; the front glass (the computed minimum in mm and the stock glass to order, null above 19 mm) and an open-top box's glass weight; and the page's table of ready-made tanks as the fixture build shows it (whole litres, water at `waterShare`, glass in mm, kg full to the nearest 5). Generated from volume.ts and the built page by apps/site/test/volume-vectors.test.ts: edit a case's inputs here (note, shape, d, refused; a glass case's sizes), then run UPDATE_VECTORS=1 pnpm --filter site test, which writes every figure; the test fails while the file differs from what the code gives. The iOS app's tests run its own code (AquaTomeKit Tanks/Volume.swift) on the same cases, to 1e-9. A refusal gives the site's Vietnamese sentence (`error`) and, for the app, what it is (`refused`, written by hand): ["missing", field] for a size not above 0 (the page asks for it: "Nhập rộng."), ["shorter", field, than] for a pane longer than the side it sits on, ["fill"] for a water line not above 0 or above the rim.

shapes.note: a box: length × width × height
a water line below the rim fills only that far
a water line at the rim is the whole tank: no second figure
sizes typed in inches (23.6 × 12 × 14 in), as the page turns them into cm
a cube: one side, its own height
a cube filled to 20 cm
elongated hexagon: W × (L + F) / 2
a hexagon whose front is as long as the tank is a box
octagon: L × W less four corners
flat-back hexagon: L × W less the two front corners
cylinder, by its diameter
half cylinder, by its flat back
quarter circle, by the side on the wall
ellipse
corner pentagon: A × A less the front triangle
L-shape: the shared corner counted once
corner triangle

every side is asked for before the shape is checked
